question: What is being presented as the determination of the Kaula teaching for all time?
premises: It is addressed to the great goddess.
It is presented as the determination for all time.
inference: This Kaula teaching is, O great goddess, the determination for all time.
uncertainties: The agent of presentation is not stated in these tokens.
